sections.title: It all starts with the skeleton.
sections.text: This is how I build every website, from a simple landing page to a complex platform. Order comes first: what's read first, where people click and how it looks on a phone.

sections.title: Three layers, one experience.
sections.text: HTML organizes, CSS dresses and JavaScript brings it to life. When a project calls for it, I add a fourth: a 3D scene drawn by the graphics card, like this page.

sections.title: Design with volume.
sections.text: Color, type and real light: every element has depth, casts a shadow and reflects its surroundings. Your brand stops being flat.

sections.title: It moves with you.
sections.text: Scrolling moves the camera, and the mouse (or your phone's gyroscope) tilts the scene. Motion supports the reading instead of covering it.

sections.title: Ready to go live.
sections.text: Light, fast and built for phones too. And if your business needs it, I connect it to systems like Odoo and to artificial intelligence.
